purpose: Close the Cabot/Intrepid/Hiryu damage and return clocks generated by the 3-Feb Branch carrier exchange before using later Central-Pacific carrier wallets.
rule: Historical damage/repair cases are analogues, not automatic copies. Damage geometry, emergency stability, propulsion, flight-deck function, transit, drydock requirement, yard capacity and air-group regeneration are separate clocks.

historical_anchors.anchor: Historical 20-Nov-1943 single aircraft-torpedo hit flooded the after engine room and extensive adjacent spaces; temporary repair at Funafuti/Pearl was followed by West Coast work and return to Pearl in July 1944. This is the upper-severity same-class analogue for Cabot, not a copied duration.

Historical Essex-class survivability and forward-repair capacity support rapid recovery from localized topside damage when propulsion, steering and major machinery are intact. The Branch bomb hit is much lighter than Intrepid historical 17-Feb-1944 torpedo steering casualty.

Branch damage is one bomb plus damaging near miss in aft flight-deck/hangar region, with propulsion and waterline integrity retained. Use Japanese carrier flight-deck/hangar repair practice plus Truk/Akashi forward repair; do not import historical Hiryu loss.

USS_Cabot_CVL28.damage_geometry: One Type-91-class aerial torpedo centered on starboard aft quarter/outer shaft-alley region, aft of the worst Independence after-engineroom analogue. Local shell/blister rupture, shaft-alley flooding, one shaft/propulsion train disabled, fires controlled; no magazine loss and no catastrophic progressive flooding centered.
USS_Cabot_CVL28.immediate_state: Stable after counterflooding; flight operations closed; withdrawal speed about 17-20 kt centered with escorts.
USS_Cabot_CVL28.forward_emergency: Majuro/forward service support 1944-02-04..02-06 after the anchorage is secured; pumps, shoring, patching and shaft isolation only, no claim of drydock restoration.
USS_Cabot_CVL28.transit: Depart eastward after stabilization; Pearl arrival band 1944-02-11..02-15.
USS_Cabot_CVL28.pearl: Drydock survey/temporary structural and shaft work about 1 week; permanent repair best done in West Coast yard because underwater/shaft-line alignment and carrier services require more than a forward patch.
USS_Cabot_CVL28.major_yard: Hunters Point/West Coast arrival centered late February.
USS_Cabot_CVL28.guard: Cabot is unavailable for the Branch Truk raid/HAILSTONE window and March carrier operations unless a later survey explicitly downgrades the shaft damage. Surviving air-group aircraft can be cross-decked or based ashore but do not create another flight deck.

USS_Intrepid_CV11.damage_geometry: One bomb through/near flight-deck-elevator-side working area with splinter/fire damage; no propulsion, steering, avgas-main or major structural casualty centered.
USS_Intrepid_CV11.emergency_patch: 1944-02-03 afternoon-evening; damaged deck plating cut/covered, firefighting and elevator-side services isolated.
USS_Intrepid_CV11.permanent_repair: Short Majuro/Pearl availability later when operational tempo permits; not campaign-out.
USS_Intrepid_CV11.guard: Do not convert the temporary 3-Feb interruption into a multi-week absence; likewise do not erase reduced deck efficiency during the 3-Feb counterstrike.

IJN_Hiryu.damage_geometry: One US carrier bomb plus damaging near miss centered aft; aft flight deck/hangar plating and local services distorted/burned, but propulsion, steering, magazines and underwater hull remain serviceable.
IJN_Hiryu.underway_emergency: 1944-02-03..02-05; fires, shoring, deck clearance, temporary watertight/utility isolation while withdrawing west.
IJN_Hiryu.Akashi_forward_repair: 1944-02-05..02-15 centered; deck plating/supports, hangar services, arresting/recovery fittings and blast/fire damage.
IJN_Hiryu.reason_for_later_team_gate: 3-Feb air-group/cadre attrition, cross-decking and training debt continue after the physical deck is patched.
IJN_Hiryu.guard: Hull repair does not regenerate lost D4Y/B6N leaders, navigators or multi-seat crews. Do not count Hiryu as a full combat deck before the team gate.

wallet_effects.US: From 4 Feb, Intrepid returns near-normal; Cabot remains out. TF58 has 5 CV + 5 CVL physical fast decks for immediate operations, with surviving Cabot aircraft redistributed subject to deck/maintenance congestion.
wallet_effects.Japan: Shokaku/Zuikaku remain operational but withdraw. Hiryu leaves the combat deck pool until mid/late Feb. Soryu trial/team-readiness remains a separate 5-15 Feb gate and can restore a third first-line deck before Hiryu only if its own team gate is passed.
